newsitem.title: USA: BIG B sets Oct 25 deadline for bidders.
newsitem.headline: BIG B sets Oct 25 deadline for bidders.

text.p: Big B Inc said Wednesday that parties interested in acquiring the company have until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on October 25 to submit their bids.
The company disclosed the deadline in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

In an October 15 letter, Big B's financial adviser, Robinson-Humphrey, informed potential bidders that signed confidentiality pacts, including Revco D.S. Inc, that they must submit written bids by the deadline, the filing said.
Big B's board expected to meet during the weekend of October 26 to consider any bids received and to authorize the company to enter into a merger agreement if one of them is acceptable.

The majority of the parties that had previously executed confidentiality agreements have accepted Big B's offer to revise their confidentiality agreements in accordance with the Revco confidentiality accord, the filing said.
Failure by any potential bidders to file with Robinson-Humphrey by the deadline will be taken to mean that such the bidder is not interested in acquiring Big B, the filing said.
